1 Underwater photographer Thomas Friedrich and his partner, Patricia Guar- diola Rico, have a dream that is probab- ly shared by many other divers – with the difference that they are making theirs come true. The couple is embar- king on a motorhome tour and exploring the best underwater diving spots along the way in the company of well-known locals. They’ll meet free diver Phil Sima to visit the Verzasca granite labyrinth and join shark expert Isaias Cruz in Bil- bao to encounter Atlantic blue and mako sharks. Further destinations along their route will be the caves and caverns at Alicante, the colourful gorgonian forests off the Costa Brava, and Second World War submarine wrecks at Marseilles. Their journey will be a celebration of freedom and independence. Many of the dives will be in remote areas. Here they naturally need an onboard supply of pure breathing air which is safe, relia- ble and – most important of all – inde- pendent of a mains power source. The solution is a petrol-driven mobile BAUER compressor. system monitors breathing air and Nitrox in real time according to DIN EN 12021:2014. It measures CO, CO₂, O₂, humidity, and VOCs, and protects with automatic shutdown in case of limit exceedance. The CO ping test checks sensors before start. With B-CLOUD, digital documentation and remote access are possible. Optionally, contaminated air can be vented automatically outdoors. B-CLOUD & B-APP With BAUER B-CLOUD and the B-APP, users can keep an eye on their compressor system at all times, even remotely. Operating data, maintenance instructions, and status messages are transmitted and visualized in real time. This increases transparency, simplifies monitoring, and supports optimized maintenance planning. In addition, the stored operating data in the B-CLOUD is available for later analysis and system performance optimization. B-LINK Wi-Fi and 4G routers enable the wireless communication of the B-CONTROL MICRO with the B-CLOUD. They establish a reliable Wi-Fi or mobile network connection, allowing secure remote access to the compressor system. B-SECURUS filter monitoring The B-SECURUS system monitors the saturation of the filter cartridge(s) by measuring the moisture level in the molecular sieve and provides a timely indication when a cartridge replacement is required – either on the display or via the control unit. Once saturation is reached, the system automatically shuts down the unit. The B-SECURUS filter monitoring system can only be used in conjunction with the P 41, P 61,

The first choice in these situations is usually the portable line from BAUER, especially the JUNIOR II, which has been tried and tested over the de- cades. If the system can be operated from a stationary ship and larger quantities of air are required, mobile systems such as the MARINER and PE-TE series are often used.
